name: phase_utilization_variants
description: GPU rollout validation of the phase-utilization screening winners (V2/V4/V6), trained from the frozen-protocol phaseforge stage-1 checkpoints (same outputs base, same revision). Each cell is the protocol-identical PhaseForge stage-2 cell plus a single screened mechanism channel, per docs/research/phase_utilization_design.md sections 5-10. The official PhaseForge row (V0) comes from experiments/five_task.json in the same outputs base. Screening evidence (3 seeds, CPU): V2 -6.2% and V4 -6.7% best val/loss_action vs V0 on all three seeds; V6 phase-decoded routing reaches parity with the learned router. This manifest is NOT part of the frozen protocol; it is the pre-registered variant validation.

methods.name: phaseforge
methods.role: provider (frozen-protocol stage 1, never retrained if present in the outputs base)

methods.name: v2_phase_distill
methods.role: screening winner: stage-2 phase-distill warmup (KL annealed to zero by epoch 40)

methods.name: v4_phase_balance
methods.role: screening winner: phase-conditional expert balance (router balance_coeff 0.0)

methods.name: v6_anchored_router
methods.role: screening winner: phase-anchored router (low-rank anchor, rank 4)
